## Highlights
### Improved
- Sidebar folders indent the tabs and folders they hold, a closed folder is as tall as a tab, tabs deep in nested folders keep rounded corners, and opening a folder that holds open folders slides its contents in smoothly. - On iPhone and iPad, a closed folder is as tall as a tab, and its whole row still opens it.
### Fixed
- Dragging a pinned tab in a Space whose group shares its pinned tabs works again: the tile lifts under the pointer, the other pins move aside, and it lands where you let go. - A pinned tab you drag stays under the pointer when the window sits at the top of the screen, instead of drawing a row or two below it. - Opening a folder inside another folder slides its contents in smoothly instead of showing them all at once. - Opening a folder no longer makes the rows below it jump up for a moment before it slides open. - A tab dragged out of a folder keeps its icon and title in place, and dragging several pinned tabs a Sub-Space shares with its group shows them under the pointer. - Dragging several selected tabs keeps the icon and title of each tab from inside a folder in place as they lift. - A click on a folder that is closing reaches the row sliding up in its place instead of a tab inside the folder. - Dragging several selected tabs over a window showing another Space no longer offers a Split View there that would not take them.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
